subject: Geography
description: Important Himalayan + other Indian mountain passes

questions.stem: KHYBER PASS (historical entry route into India) lies in:
questions.explanation: KHYBER PASS — through HINDU KUSH mountains, on Pakistan-Afghanistan border (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province). Length 53 km; elevation ~1070 m. HISTORIC INVASION ROUTE into India for ALL major invaders: Aryans, Persians, Greeks (Alexander), Mauryans (other way), Huns, Kushans, Mongols (briefly), Mahmud of Ghazni, Muhammad Ghori, Babur (1526). Connected SILK ROUTE; today connects Peshawar (Pak) to Kabul (Afg). NOW within Pakistan post-1947 (Durand Line). Other historical Indian PASSES: BOLAN PASS (Pak-Afg, alt route through Balochistan); HINDU KUSH passes (Khyber, Khojak). Within MODERN INDIA: NATHU LA (Sikkim-Tibet), ROHTANG (HP), ZOJI LA (J&K-Ladakh), SHIPKI LA, KARAKORAM PASS. India-China BORDER passes used in historical trade.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.explanation: ZOJI LA — strategic pass; connects KASHMIR VALLEY (Srinagar) to LADAKH (Kargil + Leh). Elevation ~3528 m. ON NH-1 (national highway). HEAVY SNOW in winter (Nov-May closes); cleared by BRO (Border Roads Org). ZOJI LA TUNNEL (under construction; ~14 km, will be longest road tunnel in Asia at 3000 m altitude) — will keep this strategic route open year-round (vital for army supply to Ladakh + Siachen). 1948 OPERATION ZOJI LA: Indian army recaptured pass from Pakistan in Indo-Pak war (used TANKS at high altitude — first ever). OTHER LADAKH ACCESS: MANALI-LEH highway (via Rohtang + Tang Lang La + Baralacha — many high passes); also via SHYOK + KARAKORAM passes (military). NEW ATAL TUNNEL (2020) under Rohtang — keeps Manali-Leh route accessible longer.

questions.stem: NATHU LA pass on Sikkim-China border was reopened for trade in:
questions.explanation: NATHU LA — pass between SIKKIM (India) + Tibet (China); altitude ~4310 m. CLOSED in 1962 after Sino-Indian war. REOPENED for limited trade in 2006 (after 44 years!). On historic SILK ROUTE branch. Strategic significance: closest land route from India to Lhasa (Tibet); important during 1962 + 1965 wars; 2017 DOKLAM standoff nearby. Nearby: JELEPLA (also pass), GURUDONGMAR LAKE. Other India-China passes (closed for civilian use, often LAC tensions): SHIPKI LA (HP-Tibet), LIPULEKH (Uttarakhand-Tibet), MANA + NITI passes (Uttarakhand). KAILASH-MANSAROVAR YATRA — Indian Hindus go to Mt Kailash via Lipulekh pass (Uttarakhand) or Nathu La. INDIA-CHINA border = LINE OF ACTUAL CONTROL (LAC), 3488 km long, undefined formally.

questions.stem: BOMDILA + SE LA passes are in which state?
questions.explanation: BOMDILA + SE LA — passes in ARUNACHAL PRADESH; on route from Tezpur (Assam) to TAWANG via West Kameng + Tawang districts. SE LA at 4170 m on Arunachal Pradesh-Tibet border. Strategic — 1962 war battles fought here (CHINA reached Bomdila + Tezpur briefly before withdrawing). SE LA TUNNEL (inaugurated 2024, by Modi): world's longest bi-lane road tunnel above 13,000 ft (~13 km long); year-round access to Tawang for army (vital, given proximity to LAC + 'Arunachal' is claimed by China as 'South Tibet'). Tawang Monastery (Buddhist, 17th century, second-largest in Asia after Lhasa's Potala) — Dalai Lama 6th was born nearby. Recent geopolitical heat: Tawang clash December 2022 (LAC scuffle).

questions.stem: ROHTANG PASS (now bypassed by Atal Tunnel) connects:
questions.explanation: ROHTANG PASS — Himachal Pradesh; ~3978 m. Connects Kullu (Manali) to LAHAUL valley + then Spiti, Ladakh. ROHTANG = 'pile of corpses' (Tibetan) — many travellers died crossing in storms historically. Closed Nov-May (snow). ATAL TUNNEL (inaugurated 2020, named after Vajpayee): 9.02 km — bypasses Rohtang, keeps Manali-Lahaul route open year-round. World's longest highway tunnel above 10,000 ft. Reduced 4-5 hour Manali-Keylong drive to ~10 min via tunnel. Strategic for LADAKH access from Manali side. ROHTANG itself still scenic destination (open in summer; tourism). PARALLEL passes in HP: BARALACHA LA (4890 m, Manali-Leh route), TANGLANG LA (5328 m), KUNZUM LA (Spiti).

questions.stem: PALGHAT GAP (or Palakkad Gap) is in:

options.option_text: Western Ghats — between Kerala + Tamil Nadu

questions.explanation: PALGHAT GAP / PALAKKAD GAP — major BREAK in Western Ghats; ~40 km wide, between NILGIRI HILLS (north) + ANNAMALAI HILLS (south). Connects Kerala (Palakkad town) + Tamil Nadu (Coimbatore). KEY CORRIDOR for: railway (Tipu Sultan-era; Madras-Cochin RAIL); road (NH 544); MONSOON winds (allows SW monsoon to penetrate Tamil Nadu — explains some TN rainfall). LOCATION strategically + culturally important. OTHER PENINSULAR GAPS in Western Ghats: GOA GAP, BHOR GHAT (near Mumbai-Pune), Thal Ghat. EASTERN GHATS — fragmented, many gaps; rivers cut through (Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna delta lowlands).

questions.stem: KARAKORAM PASS (highest pass on India's old SILK ROUTE) is at altitude:
questions.explanation: KARAKORAM PASS — 5540 m, between LADAKH (India) + Xinjiang (China). One of HIGHEST motorable passes — though motorable now in summer with caution; historically only by yak / mule. Once part of SILK ROUTE branch via Yarkand-Leh. Closed since 1949 (China occupation of Tibet/Xinjiang). India SUSPENDED traffic. KHARDUNG LA (Ladakh, 5359 m) — once claimed 'world's highest motorable road' (claim disputed). UMLING LA (recent, 5883 m, also Ladakh) — currently world's HIGHEST motorable road, opened 2017 by BRO. India is MOUNTAINOUS — many high-altitude road records. CHALLENGES: oxygen ~50% of sea level; vehicles labour; engines need carburettor adjustment.
